`runLive` now takes an injected `toResults(result, ctx)` and calls it for both modes. vitest passes (536 passed, 6 skipped), and tsc and lint are clean. Only `src/server/live/run-live.ts` and `tests/live/run-live.test.ts` changed; `config.ts` and `validate.ts` are untouched.

REVIEW REPORT

1. EXPORTS
run-live.ts:
- LIVE_RUN_CONFIG: RunConfig (line 27)
- LIVE_SEARCH_SORT: { field: "crustdata_company_id", order: "asc" } (36)
- SYNTHETIC_NOTICES: readonly string[] (38)
- interface Usage { runsRemaining, searched, enriched, providerCostUsd } (45)
- interface ResultsContext { mode: CodeMode; model: "fake" | "claude-haiku" } (54)
- type ToResults = (result: PipelineResult, ctx: ResultsContext) => unknown (59)
- type LiveBody (61)
- interface LiveOutcome { httpStatus; body } (79)
- liveUnavailable(): LiveOutcome (125)
- interface LiveProviderBundle { provider, budget } (143)
- interface LiveDeps (148)
- realFactories: Pick<LiveDeps, "createProvider" | "createLlm"> (164)
- runLive(request: { code: unknown; icp: unknown }, ip: string, deps: LiveDeps): Promise<LiveOutcome> (183)
LiveDeps fields:
- store: LiveStore
- hmacSecret: string
- live: LiveKeys | null
- now: () => Date
- createProvider(keys, config)
- createLlm(keys)
- synthetic?: SyntheticDependencies
- toResults: ToResults
validate.ts:
- ALLOWED_SIZES
- AllowedSize
- InvalidField
- FIELD_MESSAGES
- ValidRequest
- Validation
- validateRequest(request: { code: unknown; icp: unknown }): Validation
config.ts:
- LiveKeys
- LiveConfig
- LiveConfigResult
- readLiveConfig(env = process.env): LiveConfigResult
- connectStore(databaseUrl): Promise<{ store; close }>
config.ts is unchanged.

2. FLOW (store calls in order)
- invalid_request: 400, validation fails. No store calls. Line 190.
- invalid_request (industry): 400, no autocomplete match. Store calls: hit, reserveRun, releaseRun. Lines 319-320.
- rate_limited: 429, IP over 20 per 60s. Store calls: hit. Line 200.
- rate_limited: 429, over 5 bad codes per 900s. Store calls: hit, reserveRun, hit. Line 210.
- live_disabled: 503, kill switch off. Store calls: hit, isLiveEnabled. Line 202.
- invalid_code: 401, unknown, malformed or disabled code. Store calls: hit, isLiveEnabled, reserveRun, hit. Line 211.
- no_runs_left: 403. Store calls: hit, isLiveEnabled, reserveRun. Line 214.
- run_in_progress: 409. Same store calls. Line 216.
- live_unavailable: 503, unknown reserve reason (default case). Line 218.
- live_unavailable: 503, any store or HMAC throw before the run exists. Nothing to release. Line 223.
- run_failed: 502, live keys null, factory throws, autocomplete fails or is empty. Store calls: hit, isLiveEnabled, reserveRun, releaseRun. Lines 297-305, 330.
- run_failed: 502, pipeline throws. Store calls: finishRun with status failed. Line 350.
- budget_exhausted: 503, pipeline stopped on budget_cap_reached. Store calls: finishRun with status budget_exhausted. Line 378.
- run_failed: 502, pipeline stopped for another reason. Store calls: finishRun with status failed. Line 378.
- run_failed: 502, toResults throws, live mode. Store calls: finishRun failed with the measured counts and cost. Line 385.
- run_failed: 502, synthetic rejected, or toResults or finishRun throws in synthetic mode. Store calls: finishRun failed (failed() at 269, catch at 254-255).
- run_failed: 502, live finishRun throws. The exception reaches the outer catch, which calls failed(). Lines 254-255.
- ok: 200, synthetic. Store calls: hit, isLiveEnabled, reserveRun, finishRun completed. Line 282.
- ok: 200, live. Same store calls. Line 395.

3. IMPORTS FROM OUTSIDE src/server
- ../../core/agent/llm (LlmClient type): the type of the injected model client.
- ../../core/agent/improved-pipeline (runImprovedPipeline): runs the live pipeline.
- ../../core/agent/types (IcpInput, PipelineResult types): the pipeline input and result types.
- ../../core/data/provider (BudgetGuard, BudgetSnapshot, CompanyProvider): the budget guard for the real provider factory, plus types.
- ../../core/types (DEFAULT_RUN_CONFIG, RunConfig): the base for LIVE_RUN_CONFIG.
- ../../app/results/_lib/synthetic-run (runSyntheticPipeline, syntheticDependencies, SyntheticDependencies): the synthetic runner, the only src/app import.
- Dynamic imports inside realFactories: core/data/crustdata-provider and core/agent/gateway-client. The real factories are lazy so the SDKs never load in synthetic mode or in tests.
- The removed imports are gone: toResultsDto, ResultsDto, ProspectDto, loadSyntheticResults.

4. LIVE FACTORIES
- Injected factories are deps.createProvider(keys, config) and deps.createLlm(keys), with real versions in realFactories (line 164).
- They are called only at lines 314-315, inside runLiveMode.
- runLiveMode is reached only from the ternary at lines 251-253, when the reserved mode, which comes from the store, is not "synthetic".
- runSynthetic (line 266) never touches them. It uses only deps.synthetic or syntheticDependencies.
- Tests assert createProvider and createLlm are not called in synthetic mode, including with live: null.

5. SAFETY
- Nothing is logged: yes. No console or logger use anywhere in the file.
- No body can contain a key, invite code, upstream error text, stack trace or company data: NO as a blanket claim. Every error body is a fixed message from the MESSAGES table (lines 90-100), but the 200 body's `results` is whatever the injected toResults returns, so it is not enforced here. Garvit's mapper must keep upstream text and error messages out of its output. The notices, built from fixed strings and issue codes, contain only the matched industry name (line 353, truncated to 80 characters). This is a regression: I deleted the old scrubProspect, which replaced model and provider error text in failed assessments.
- Same 401 body for unknown, malformed and disabled codes: yes. Lines 209-211, with a test.
- Early failures call releaseRun: yes (297-305, 319). Later failures call finishRun: yes (237, 350, 374, 385).
- If releaseRun throws: swallowed (301), and 502 run_failed is returned. If it throws at line 319, control passes to the catch at 329, which calls release() again, then returns 502.
- If finishRun throws on a failure path, settle() swallows it (231) and 502 run_failed is returned.
- If finishRun throws on a success path (274 or 388), the outer catch at 254 returns failed(), which tries finishRun once more and then returns 502. A completed run whose finishRun fails is reported as 502, with zero counts if the second attempt succeeds.

6. NOT DONE or DIFFERENT
- The model passed to toResults is hard-coded: "fake" for synthetic, "claude-haiku" for live. It is not read from LIVE_RUN_CONFIG.model.
- ctx.mode uses the CodeMode type from store.ts, which I assumed is "synthetic" | "live". tsc accepts it.
- A toResults failure in live mode stores errorCategory "results_mapping". It is a new, undocumented category, so check that finishRun and the database accept it.
- Synthetic notices still come from SYNTHETIC_NOTICES plus noticesFromIssues. Live notices still use ISSUE_NOTICES.
- The synthetic ICP is fixed by runSyntheticPipeline, so the request ICP is still ignored in synthetic mode.
- The route does not exist yet, so runLive is not wired to a real toResults.

7. TESTS
run-live.test.ts:
- returns 400 invalid_request before touching the store
- rate limits by IP: the 21st request in a window gets 429
- returns 503 live_disabled when the kill switch is off, without reserving
- gives identical 401 bodies for unknown, malformed and disabled codes
- limits bad codes per IP: the 6th wrong code in 15 minutes gets 429
- does not count successful runs towards the bad-code limit
- returns 403 no_runs_left
- returns 409 run_in_progress while a run holds the lock
- returns 503 live_unavailable when store.hit, isLiveEnabled or reserveRun fails, and constructs nothing (3 cases)
- returns 503 live_unavailable for an unusable HMAC secret
- exports a fixed live_unavailable outcome for callers without configuration
- gives 502 run_failed and finishes the run when finishRun is the thing that fails
- synthetic: runs the synthetic pipeline, never builds live dependencies, and needs no live config
- synthetic: calls toResults once with the synthetic ctx and a pipeline result (new)
- synthetic: fails with 502 and finishes the run if toResults throws, without leaking (new)
- synthetic: ignores the ICP, so any valid criteria give the same results
- synthetic: always carries both fixed notices
- synthetic: fails with 502 and finishes the run if the synthetic pipeline throws
- live: builds the provider and model client from config, uses the first autocomplete suggestion, and completes
- live: calls toResults once with the live ctx and never with mode synthetic (new)
- live: does not call toResults when a live run is released or stopped (new)
- live: finishes a live run as failed with its measured counts if toResults throws (new)
- live: pins the run config and search sort the spec requires
- live: releases the run and returns 400 on field industry when nothing matches
- live: releases the run (no finishRun) on autocomplete failure
- live: releases the run when live configuration is missing
- live: releases the run when a factory throws, without leaking the error
- live: maps a provider budget_cap_reached before any result to 503 budget_exhausted
- live: maps any other provider failure to 502 run_failed
- live: absorbs model errors per company and never echoes their text
- live: adds a notice for partial enrichment
- live: sends the matched industry, sizes and country to the pipeline
- no leaks: never puts keys, codes, the HMAC secret or upstream text in any response body
- no leaks: gives every non-200 body a status and a fixed message string
validate.test.ts:
- accepts a valid request and normalises it
- rejects code (8 cases)
- accepts a 64-character code
- rejects icp (5 cases)
- rejects industry (6 cases)
- accepts industry lengths 2 and 80
- rejects country (4 cases)
- rejects sizes (7 cases)
- uses a fixed message per field and never echoes input
- reports the first failing field in order: code, icp, industry, country, sizes
Results:
- vitest: 34 files passed and 1 skipped; 536 tests passed and 6 skipped
- tsc --noEmit: no errors
- npm run lint: no errors

content.text:
SHORT REVIEW REPORT

All four changes are in and vitest, tsc and lint are clean. Only `src/server/live/run-live.ts` and `tests/live/run-live.test.ts` changed.

1. KILL SWITCH (run-live.ts lines 318-331, giveBack at 364)
- The switch is no longer read before `reserveRun`.
- After a successful reservation, a live-mode code reads `isLiveEnabled()`. If it is off, the run is released and the response is 503 live_disabled. If the read throws, the run is released and the response is 503 live_unavailable.
- A synthetic code never reads the switch.
- The header comment and the shared `giveBack()` helper were updated. `runLiveMode` now uses `giveBack` as well.

2. COMPLETED RUN NEVER REPORTED AS FAILED (finishCompleted at 374; used at 400 for synthetic and 510 for live)
- `finishRun(completed)` is tried twice. If both attempts throw, the 200 with the results is still returned. No other status is written, and nothing is logged.
- The failure paths still use `settle` / `failed()` as before, so a failed run whose `finishRun` throws still gives 502 run_failed.
- The earlier behaviour (a thrown success-path `finishRun` giving 502) is gone. I rewrote the one test that asserted it.

3. SCRUB BEFORE THE MAPPER (scrubResult at 165, called at 399 and 505)
- `scrubResult` returns a copy and never mutates its input. Both modes call it right before `toResults`.
- In live mode a `scrubResult` throw lands in the `results_mapping` failure path. In synthetic mode it lands in the outer catch, so the run is recorded as failed.
- Scrubbed (fixed text by code or reason, generic fixed string for unknown ones):
  - issues[].message, keyed by issue code and reusing ISSUE_NOTICES.
  - prospects[].assessment.message when the assessment failed, keyed by reason.
  - prospects[].validation and search_validation issues[].reason, keyed by issue code. These were built in code but embed company values.
  - prospects[].checks assessment and claims findings[].message, keyed by finding code. These embed model-supplied criterion names, fact ids and numbers.
  - run.input_description, which holds user and provider text. It is now a fixed string.
  - findings[].fact_id and findings[].criterion, which are model-supplied strings. I dropped them from the copy.
- Judged safe and passed through:
  - raw company records, facts (claim, source ids and URLs) and the model's assessment (scores, uncertainty notes, outreach). These are the intended payload, not error text.
  - Enums, ids, timestamps, numbers, usage and cost, and the metrics maps keyed by closed enums.
  - llm_call.model, which is the configured model name.
  - filters, which hold the provider-matched industry label, the country and the size ranges.

4. CLEANUP
- `ctx.model` for live is now `LIVE_RUN_CONFIG.model`, and `ResultsContext.model` is typed `string`.
- The exported `Usage` interface is removed and its fields are inlined in `LiveBody`.
- The local `reserved` type is replaced by the existing `Reserved` interface.
- The rest of the file is used, so I found no other dead code.

NEW AND CHANGED TESTS
- "returns 503 live_disabled for a live code when the switch is off, and gives the run back" (replaces the old kill-switch test)
- "runs a synthetic code normally when the switch is off, never reading the switch"
- "runs a live code when the switch is on"
- "releases the run and gives 503 live_unavailable when reading the switch fails after reservation"
- "still gives 502 run_failed when a failed run's finishRun also throws" (replaces the old finishRun-fails test)
- "retries finishRun once and returns 200" (synthetic and live)
- "still returns 200 with the results when finishRun always throws" (synthetic and live)
- scrubResult: "replaces every upstream-capable field with fixed text and does not mutate its input"
- scrubResult: "uses a generic fixed text for unknown codes and reasons"
- scrubResult: "passes company data and model assessments through unchanged"
- scrubResult: "hands toResults a scrubbed result in both modes"
- "gives every non-200 body…" now uses the live code for its switch-off case.

RESULTS
- vitest: 34 files passed, 1 skipped; 547 tests passed, 6 skipped
- tsc --noEmit: no errors
- lint: no errors or warnings

UNSURE
- Dropping `fact_id` and `criterion` from check findings may remove something the mapper wants. It is a one-line change to keep them.
- `filters.industries` is the provider's autocomplete label. I left it as data, but it is upstream text. It is also the label already shown in the notices.
- Raw company fields and facts can contain whatever the provider returned for a company. They are the product, so I did not scrub them.
- The marker test covers the fields I scrub. The two-mode integration test makes the model throw `UPSTREAM-LEAK` and checks the mapper's input is clean.
- The unknown-reason and unknown-code fallbacks are tested with forced casts, because the types are closed enums.
- The earlier `results_mapping` errorCategory question is still open.
